models.name: yunet
models.notes: Face box and 5 landmarks. BGR, 0-255, no normalisation; fixed 640x640 input, so frames are letterboxed.

models.name: sface
models.notes: 128-d face embedding for 1:1 verification (ADR 0001). RGB, 0-255, aligned with YuNet's 5 points. Training data is not documented upstream (the SFace paper uses research-only datasets).

models.name: minifasnet_v2
models.notes: Passive PAD, face box scaled 2.7x. BGR, 0-255; softmax index 1 = real. Converted to ONNX by tools/export_minifasnet.py (modified from the original PyTorch weights). Training data is not documented upstream.

models.name: minifasnet_v1se
models.notes: Passive PAD, face box scaled 4.0x (sees bezels and paper edges). BGR, 0-255; softmax index 1 = real. Converted to ONNX by tools/export_minifasnet.py (modified from the original PyTorch weights). Training data is not documented upstream.
